description: Assassin's Creed Hexe is the next mainline title in the series, but Ubisoft has not announced a release window for the title. An industry insider, however, has claimed that the game will not launch before the second half of 2027 at the earliest. Assassin's Creed Hexe was announced in 2022.
title: Assassin's Creed Hexe Will Not Release Until Second Half of 2027 at the Earliest, Claims Insider

description: A fresh leak has revealed the expected specifications and design of the Nokia 100 (2026) ahead of its official debut. The feature phone is tipped to include a VGA rear camera, a larger 1,020mAh battery, Bluetooth 4.2, FM radio and support for microSD cards up to 32GB. It is also said to run on the S30+ operating system, offer an IP54 rating, and arrive in Black, Cyan and Purple colour options with the Snake game pre-installed.
title: Nokia 100 (2026) Leak Suggests New Design and Battery Upgrade

description: Rising memory prices and supply shortages have negatively affected the technology sector. This situation also hiked prices of products ranging from smartphones, tablets, smart glasses, gaming consoles and laptops to compact computing devices. Now, Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon reportedly said the company plans to expand its margins by increasing chip prices starting September 1.
title: Qualcomm to Reportedly Raise Snapdragon Chip Prices, Android Phones Could Get Costlier

description: Hungary has relaxed its cryptocurrency regulations by removing additional validator requirements that went beyond the European Union's MiCA framework. The policy change comes after the country's finance minister acknowledged that the earlier rules had disrupted the local crypto market and prompted firms to halt operations. The revised approach is expected to support the return of crypto businesses, including Budapest-based exchange CoinCash, which is preparing to resume services after pursuing MiCA authorisation.
title: Hungary Eases Crypto Rules as CoinCash Prepares to Resume Operations

description: Oppo Find X10 series and Vivo X500 series are expected to launch this year as the flagship offerings from the respective brands. According to a tipster, both lineups could be launched in India around the upcoming Diwali festive season. The two smartphone makers are said to continue their recent strategy of launching two flagship models in the country instead of bringing their global lineups that are available in global markets.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series, Vivo X500 Series Tipped to Launch in India Before Diwali

description: A new leak suggests Vivo is preparing an FE-branded smartphone for its upcoming S2 lineup instead of introducing a Pro model. The Vivo S2 FE is said to arrive after the standard Vivo S2 5G, while the company has already begun teasing the series in India. Earlier reports indicate the Vivo S2 5G could feature a MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, a 120Hz AMOLED screen, a 7,050mAh battery and dual rear cameras.
title: Vivo S2 FE Could Replace Vivo S2 Pro in India, Leak Suggests

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 lineup has surfaced in numerous leaks recently. Now, a Samsung executive reportedly confirmed the arrival of the new tablets. The lineup is said to include three models. Meanwhile, the Galaxy Tab S12+ received certification from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC). The listings reveal the model number and connectivity details of the upcoming device.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Series Launch Reportedly Confirmed; Galaxy Tab S12+ Visits US FCC Database

description: Samsung Electronics on Thursday reported a more than 250-fold jump in chip profit and announced multi-year supply deals with major data centre operators, saying it expects global chip shortages to become more acute and extend into 2028.
title: Samsung Sees Chip Shortage Extending to 2028, Touts Long-Term Supply Deals

description: OpenAI president Greg Brockman has outlined the company's broader hardware strategy, revealing that it is developing multiple AI-powered devices rather than a single product. He also discussed OpenAI's vision for voice-first computing, the expected arrival of its first hardware products, privacy improvements for Temporary Chat and changes planned for the ChatGPT desktop app. Brockman said the company remains focused on its own technology roadmap while continuing to expand AI features and prepare new hardware for future launches.
title: OpenAI Confirms Plans for a Family of AI Hardware Products

description: Sony is set to be a major beneficiary of the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 but the highly anticipated game is landing as the PlayStation maker grapples with rising prices of memory chips. The company has a long history with Take-Two Interactive Software, which will launch its delayed GTA 6 on November 19.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Set to Boost Sony's PS5 Amidst Rising Memory Prices

description: Redmi K100 series is expected to make its debut in China tomorrow (Friday). While the Xiaomi sub-brand has yet to officially reveal the name of the upcoming smartphones, it has already begun sharing teasers. Ahead of its anticipated debut, a new Redmi smartphone has been teased on social media, providing the first official glimpse of its design. Separately, a promotional image of the purported Redmi K100 Pro Max has also leaked, which shows its colour option and rear camera layout.
title: Redmi K100 Series Design Teased Ahead of July 31 Launch; Redmi K100 Pro Max Promo Image Surfaces

description: Google has announced the rollout of Lyria 3.5, its newest AI music generation model, through Flow Music. The update improves melody generation, lyric writing, vocal realism and creative controls, allowing users to better customise AI-generated songs. Google said the model also offers stronger prompt adherence and improved pronunciation. The launch builds on earlier versions of Lyria, which already support text, image and video-based music generation, while Flow Music continues to add more editing tools for creators.
title: Google Rolls Out Lyria 3.5 AI Music Model in Flow Music With Richer Melodies and Vocals

description: Flipkart has announced the launch of Flipkart Pay Later in India. It offers customers three repayment options. The Pay Later offers up to 30 days for everyday purchases. The Pay in 3 option splits the cost across three payments, and EMI plans ranging from three to 12 months for higher-value categories, including mobiles. The Flipkart Pay Later programme was launched in association with PayU Finance.
title: Flipkart Pay Later Launched in India With Flexible Repayment Options

description: Poco M8 Power will be launched in India with an octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset from Qualcomm, the company confirmed on Thursday. The company claims that the handset managed to score more than 6,30,000 points on the AnTuTu benchmarking platform. Moreover, the Poco M8 Power is confirmed to feature 8GB of RAM, with support for virtual RAM expansion of up to 8GB. The smartphone will also be equipped with a vapour chamber cooling solution, featuring a 10,416 sq mm Graphite heat dissipation area for thermal management. The tech firm claims that the handset will provide a 48-month lag-free experience.
title: Poco M8 Power Key Specifications, Features Confirmed Days Before Launch in India

description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is expected to be launched soon, as evident by its sighting on various certification platforms lately. Although the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to confirm its next-generation ‘Fan Edition' handset, its European pricing has now leaked. A report suggests that the purported model could be more expensive than its predecessor. The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is expected to be available in three storage variants, starting at 128GB.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE to Reportedly Cost More Than Its Predecessor; Price, Launch Timeline Leaks

description: Microsoft reported that Xbox content and services declined 10 percent year-on-year in the fourth quarter of FY2026. During the company's earnings call on Wednesday, CEO Satya Nadella said Xbox was expected to return to growth by the end of FY2027.
title: Xbox Revenue Declines 10 Percent, but Microsoft CEO Expects Gaming Division to Return to Growth by End of FY27

description: Bitcoin traded above $63,000 after the US Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged. Analysts said ETF outflows and expectations around upcoming US economic data continue to limit upside despite improving market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $63,000 as Fed Pause Lifts Crypto Market Sentiment

description: Asus has announced the price details of the Asus Pad in India. The new tablet will go on sale starting 6 August on Flipkart, Asus eShop, ROG Stores, Reliance Digital and authorised retail partners. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 8300 chipset and carries 8GB of LPDDR5X RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. The tablet has a 12.2-inch 2.8K OLED display and a 9,000mAh battery.
title: Asus Pad India Price, RAM and Storage Variants Revealed; Sales Begin August 6

description: iQOO Z11 Lite is now on sale in India, the company announced on Thursday. The company is offering an instant discount of flat Rs. 1,500 with Axis Bank and SBI credit cards. Moreover, customers can avail of up to three months of no-cost EMI options. The new handset is on sale in India via Amazon and the iQOO India online store. The iQOO Z11 Lite is offered in Midnight Blue and Solar Flame colour options. The phone sports a 6.74-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen, offering up to 120Hz refresh rate, up to 1,200 nits peak brightness, and TÜV Rheinland Low Blue Light certification. It is powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset.
title: iQOO Z11 Lite With 6,500mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers
Samsung Galaxy A27 5G: The Trusted Choice for Students Under 30,000
The Phone That Keeps Up With Your Content, Not Just Your Calls

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G will be launched in India soon, the South Korean smartphone maker has confirmed. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming handset is now live on Flipkart, confirming its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. Moreover, the microsite teases the design of the phone, which appears in a green colourway. The Galaxy F70 Pro 5G is shown to feature a pill-shaped rear camera module, which will house a triple camera system. An LED flash will be placed next to the camera island.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G India Launch Teased, Flipkart Availability Confirmed

description: Oppo A7 Pro Max will be launched in China on August 4 at 2:30 pm local time (12:00 pm IST), the smartphone maker confirmed on Thursday. The tech firm has also revealed that the Oppo A7 Pro Max will go on sale in the country in three colour options, namely Dark Mountains (black), Riding the Waves (blue), and The Future is Bright (orange) (translated from Chinese). The handset will be offered in 8GB + 128GB, 12GB + 256GB, and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. The smartphone is currently available for pre-order in the country via the Oppo China online store.
title: Oppo A7 Pro Max Launch Date Revealed Along With Colour Options, Storage Variants

description: Huawei Nova 16 SE is set to launch in China on August 5. The company has started accepting pre-reservations for the upcoming phone through its Vmall in China. It is teased to come in a Cherry Blossom Snow Sky colour option and a 256GB storage option. It is rumoured to feature a 6.84-inch LTPS display with a 1.5K refresh rate. It could run on a Kirin 8020 processor.
title: Huawei Nova 16 SE Launch Date Confirmed; Pre-Orders Begin

description: Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 AI model has been launched as the latest voice model from Elon Musk’s US-based SpaceXAI, the tech giant announced on Wednesday. Grok AI users will be migrated from Grok Voice Think Fast 1.0 to Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 AI model on August 5, without requiring them to take any action. However, users can choose to stay on the older version by pinning it before the migration date. SpaceXAI has priced the Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 model at $0.08 (roughly Rs. 8) for each minute of audio.
title: Elon Musk’s SpaceXAI Launches Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0 AI Model With Improved Speech Reasoning and More

description: A fresh leak has revealed new images of Samsung's rumoured Galaxy Buds On, offering a closer look at the company's expected clip-on earbuds. The visuals indicate an open-ear design with a charging case and point towards Open Wireless Stereo technology instead of bone conduction. The earbuds are also said to be known internally as Galaxy Buds Able. Samsung has yet to confirm the product, but the device is expected to debut alongside the Galaxy S26 FE later this year.
title: Samsung Galaxy Buds On Leak Reveals Design Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Poco M8 Power has surfaced in fresh hands-on photos and a video before its India launch on August 4. The leak offers a detailed look at the handset in three colour options and points to 45W wired charging with 22.5W reverse wired charging support. The smartphone is expected to launch as a rebadged Redmi Note 17 with a Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 chipset, a 7-inch AMOLED screen, a 50-megapixel main camera and an 8,000mAh battery.
title: Poco M8 Power Live Photos Surface Online Before India Launch on August 4

description: Google Lens users are facing a bug that affects the image translation feature on Chrome. User reports on Reddit show that opening a translated image in Google Lens from Chrome's new Tab page shows a full-image preview, and the collapse function stops working. The user gets stuck with a window blocking the view of the translated image. Google has acknowledged the problem and confirmed that it is working on a fix that will be released in a future update.
title: Chrome Users Report Trouble With Google Lens; Google Says Fix Is Coming

description: Google has released a new update for the Gemini for macOS app, bringing new capabilities to the AI chatbot on Apple’s desktops and laptops. The update is currently being rolled out to all users globally. It upgrades the Gemini for macOS app with the ability to generate transcriptions from a user’s natural language voice inputs. Google says that the feature will allow users to “create, edit, and summarise” with the Gemini for macOS app, regardless of the app the user is currently using. To access the ability, users must long-press the function key on their macOS device, and then they can “speak naturally into any window” on their device. The “intelligent dictation” functionality is turned on by default, the tech giant said.
title: Google Upgrades Gemini for macOS With Ability to Transcribe, Refine Natural Language Voice Inputs, and More

description: Sony has hiked the price of the PS5 standard edition console in India. The price of the console has gone up by Rs. 15,000, from Rs. 54,990 previously to Rs. 69,990. The console has been listed on Sony's storefront with the revised price. The revised price of the PS5 digital edition has not been confirmed yet.
title: Sony Hikes Price of PS5 Standard Edition in India by Rs. 15,000

description: Vivo S2 5G is confirmed to launch in India soon as the company’s first S-series offering in nearly six years. In recent weeks, teaser images and key specifications of the upcoming handset have been leaked. Although its official launch date remains under wraps, the handset’s colourways and dimensions have now surfaced. In a separate leak, a tipster has also revealed the pricing and complete specifications of the upcoming Vivo S2 5G.
title: Vivo S2 5G Colour Options, Dimensions Leak Ahead of India Launch

description: Google has once again teased its upcoming Pixel 11 series ahead of its launch at the Made by Google 2026 event. With roughly two weeks to go before the company's next hardware showcase, the Mountain View-based tech giant’s new promotional video provides a head-on look at the upcoming Pixel 11 Pro. The teaser continues Google's "Ask more of your phone" campaign and highlights several of its first-party apps, including Gemini, Gmail, Maps, Search, and Photos.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Teased Again Ahead of August 12 Launch; Pixel Glow Design Shown

description: The launch of the Redmi K100 Pro has been recently teased in China. While the company has yet to reveal any major details about the successor to the Redmi K90 Pro Max, it has now surfaced on a benchmarking site. The listing confirms the upcoming handset’s moniker as the Redmi K100 Pro, while also revealing some of its key specifications. It is listed with a Snapdragon 8 Ge 5 chipset. The Redmi K100 Pro is expected to ship with Android 16.
title: Redmi K100 Pro Geekbench Listing Suggests Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chip, 16GB of RAM
